name: Integrals
description: Add up thin slices to find areas, totals and averages.

lessonObjectives.l1-thin-rectangles: Estimate the area under a curve with rectangles.
lessonObjectives.l2-thinner: Watch a Riemann sum converge as the number of rectangles grows.
lessonObjectives.l3-signed-area: Read $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$ as a signed area.
lessonObjectives.l4-accumulating-a-rate: Recover a total amount from its rate of change.
lessonObjectives.l5-area-undoes-slope: Derive the fundamental theorem from the accumulation function.
lessonObjectives.l6-working-backwards: Find antiderivatives of the standard functions.
lessonObjectives.l7-evaluating: Evaluate definite integrals with the fundamental theorem.
lessonObjectives.l8-between-curves: Find the area enclosed between two curves.
lessonObjectives.l10-undo-product: Integrate by parts, and choose which factor to differentiate.
lessonObjectives.l11-to-infinity: Evaluate improper integrals and decide when they converge.
lessonObjectives.l12-no-formula: Approximate an integral with the trapezium rule in code.
lessonObjectives.l13-average-as-integral: Compute the average value of a function and a continuous expected value.
